title: Prior-only low/high balance transition
hypothesis: The number of values in the lower half (1-20) of the previous 5-of-40 draw may contain one-step transition information about the lower-half count in the next draw, beyond the exact combinatorial marginal and a prior-only unconditional empirical marginal.

definitions.outcome: L_t = count of drawn values in {1,...,20}; support {0,1,2,3,4,5}.
definitions.previous_state: S_t = L_(t-1), known before target t.

protocol.split_rule: Chronological 60/20/20 over target indices 200..3403: 1922 discovery, 641 validation, 641 historical blind OOS.
protocol.scoring_order: For target t, construct M0/M1/M2 using only draws with indices strictly less than t; score L_t before updating global counts or transition counts. Then update M1 with L_t and M2 with transition S_t -> L_t.
metrics: negative log probability of observed L_t

inference.alternative: one-sided improvement; positive gain means lower loss for the second-named model
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across six preregistered Blind OOS endpoints: three model comparisons times two proper scores.

guardrails: No use of target or future draws before scoring the target.
The lower/upper split at 20/21 is fixed by the 5-of-40 domain and is not outcome-optimized.
No parameter tuning or model selection on Validation or Blind OOS.
The historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR research.
Holm correction covers the six local Q127 endpoints, not the full Q00-Q127 research family.
This is a draw-structure diagnostic, not a full five-number predictor.
No forecast freeze, Q60 record, production scorer, or existing PR is modified.
